datasets.title: Legacy Airbnb Listings in Major U.S. Cities
datasets.description: The full legacy Airbnb project file used in ECO 230, with listing names, descriptions, and image URLs removed.
datasets.approval_gate: The Kaggle metadata API reports the source license as Unknown. Obtain written redistribution permission or replace the source before public import.
datasets.privacy_assessment: No student data. Listing names, free-text descriptions, and image URLs are removed. Remaining fields describe publicly advertised listings and hosts at the time of collection.

datasets.title: Legacy U.S. Accidents 100,000-Row Sample
datasets.description: The full 100,000-row national traffic project file used in ECO 230, sampled from US-Accidents.
datasets.privacy_assessment: No student or person-level data. Rows contain public traffic-event locations and incident descriptions.

datasets.title: Legacy CMS Inpatient Charges FY2011
datasets.description: The full legacy hospital project file used in ECO 230, matching the CMS FY2011 top-100 MS-DRG provider-and-service public-use file.
datasets.source_license: U.S. Government Work / Public Use File
datasets.grain: One hospital and MS-DRG combination with at least 11 discharges
datasets.privacy_assessment: No patient or student records. This is an aggregated CMS public-use file containing provider business names and addresses.

datasets.title: Legacy NFL Big Data Bowl 2022 Special Teams
datasets.description: The full legacy special-teams project file used in ECO 230, derived from the NFL Big Data Bowl 2022 competition data.
datasets.approval_gate: The competition rules prohibit transmitting, duplicating, publishing, or redistributing competition data to people who have not agreed to the rules. Keep this bundle private unless the NFL grants permission.
datasets.grain: One player-play record for an NFL special-teams play
datasets.privacy_assessment: No student data. The file contains public professional-player identity and biographical fields, not private individuals.
